content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) at § 14.2 (p0054).**

- **Issue:** § 14.2 vests exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created for us in Vendor, leaving us only a revocable, non-transferable licence limited to the Order Form term — despite our funding the work (§ 10.2 even contemplates our payment for in-process Deliverables).
- **Rest of the section is acceptable:** § 14.1 and § 15.1 preserve Customer Data ownership; § 14.3 keeps Vendor Technology with Vendor but pulls in the perpetual § 13.2 licence for embedded material; § 14.4 blocks joint ownership. Definitions in §§ 1.4/1.8 are appropriately scoped (Deliverables exclude Vendor Technology and know-how).
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** flips § 14.2 to Customer ownership with an irrevocable Vendor assignment and perfection cooperation, and limits Vendor's use of Deliverables to performing the Services — leaving Vendor's background IP protections intact.
